entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: One of the five Clans of Tarkir, a blue-red-white clan of martial artists, mystics and monks who admire the dragons' aspect of cunning.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the five clans and the dragons.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: The ancient Jeskai khan who summoned the khans to Dirgur Stronghold and was killed by Ojutai; his writings founded the revived Way.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragonlord whose brood subjugated the Jeskai and who killed Shu Yun.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord whose brood joined Ojutai's in the attack on the khans.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The Sultai khan who betrayed the other khans to the broods of Silumgar and Ojutai.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Ojutai's former protégée who leads the Jeskai rebellion as a planeswalker and uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: A khan who killed Narset in 4559 in the original timeline.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who taught the old Jeskai of the six fires.

entities.name: Dirgur Stronghold
entities.description: The stronghold where the khans were summoned and betrayed.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: An ancient ritual that Narset puts into action, leading to the final defeat of the dragonlords.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that weakened Ojutai's forces and let the Jeskai rebellion spread.

events.summary: Shu Yun summons the khans to Dirgur Stronghold, but Tasigur has betrayed them to the dragon broods; the Jeskai are subjugated and Shu Yun murdered.
events.quote: The ensuing battle ended with the utter subjugation of the Jeskai, the murder of Shu Yun

events.summary: The Jeskai are reorganized into a new clan headed by Ojutai and his brood.
events.quote: The Jeskai were reorganized into a new Clan headed by Ojutai and his brood

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, scattered exiles flock to Narset, who declares they will defend Tarkir together.
events.quote: She took on the mantle of leadership and declared that they would defend Tarkir together.

events.summary: The invasion weakens Ojutai's forces, and hidden Jeskai archives spread, strengthening the rebellion.
events.quote: This shook the foundation of the dragonlord's power and allowed the rebellion to gain more traction.

events.summary: Narset uncovers and puts into action the Stormnexus Ritual, leading to the final defeat of the dragonlords.
events.quote: She was convinced to put it into action by the other rebellion leaders, leading to the final defeat of the dragonlords.

events.summary: Shu Yun is killed by Ojutai in exchange for the lives of his clan members.
events.quote: He was killed by Ojutai in exchange for the lives of his clan members.

events.summary: In the original timeline Narset is killed by Zurgo in 4559; in the current timeline she ignites as a planeswalker and leads the reformed clan.
events.quote: In the current timeline, she ignited as a planeswalker and has led the clan since its reformation.
